notices.message: Requeued 5 times on orders with basic.nack (requeue = true). On a quorum queue since RabbitMQ 4.3, basic.nack does not count toward x-delivery-limit, so the queue never dead-letters the message for it, and a consumer that keeps failing receives it again and again. To end the loop after some attempts, refuse it with requeue = false (it goes to the dead-letter exchange, if there is one), or use basic.reject, which counts toward the limit.
